data.title: 青山七海 · 厨房灶台前的特制厚蛋烧试吃
data.description: 傍晚樱花庄温暖的厨房内，扎着马尾系着围裙的七海刚煎好香气四溢的关西风厚蛋烧。她用筷子夹起一块吹了吹递到你嘴边，红着脸颊眼含期待地等待你的评价。
data.location: cozy communal dormitory kitchen with pots and pans
data.action: standing at stove wearing an apron, feeding partner a piece of freshly cooked rolled egg with chopsticks, blushing warmly with hopeful eyes
data.lighting: warm golden evening sunlight pouring through kitchen window
data.mood: supreme housewife devotion, sweet domestic caring, heart-melting bride charm
data.promptProse: In a cozy kitchen wearing a pink apron, Nanami Aoyama feeds partner a piece of rolled egg on chopsticks, blushing warmly with hopeful amber eyes.
